page_title: mm2t — Meeting notes for Mac that know who spoke

sources.entry: mm2t - Meeting recorder with local storage and on-device speaker recognition, using your chosen services for transcripts and summaries. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/yuzen9622/mm2t) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: mm2t
summary.one_liner: mm2t is a free, open-source Mac app that records meetings from your microphone and meeting app without a bot, identifies each speaker on-device, and writes a transcript and summary.
use_cases: Recording and transcribing video or phone meetings on a Mac
Getting a per-speaker transcript of a meeting
Pulling decisions and action items from meeting notes
Keeping meeting recordings local instead of in a cloud bot service
Building a custom vocabulary of names and terms for future meetings
summary.what_it_does: Records the microphone and the meeting app's audio directly, with no bot joining the call. Detects when Google Meet, Teams, Zoom or Webex starts and offers to record from the menu bar. Keeps mic and remote audio on separate tracks and sorts them by speaker on the Mac, with names matched to voices after they are named once. Produces a transcript where each line has a speaker and timestamp, and clicking a line plays the audio from that point. Generates a summary with decisions, discussion and action items. Stores recordings, voiceprints and notes locally and sends transcription and summary requests to a provider using the user's own API key or a self-hosted transcription server.
notable: No bot joins the call; records mic and meeting app audio directly
On-device speaker recognition with per-person voiceprints
API keys stored in macOS Keychain; recordings stay on the Mac
Can use a self-hosted transcription server instead of a cloud provider
caveats: Transcription and summaries need your own API key with a chosen provider, or a transcription server you host
Installation and supported services are documented only on GitHub
